query: WITH entities AS ((SELECT score, id FROM transfers WHERE COALESCE(account_id = $1, $1 IS NULL) AND COALESCE(status = $2, $2 IS NULL) AND (NOT $3 OR reference IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $4) AND ((score IS NULL OR (score, id) < ($7, $6))) AND ($6 IS NOT NULL AND $7 IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY score DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC LIMIT $5) UNION ALL (SELECT score, id FROM transfers WHERE COALESCE(account_id = $1, $1 IS NULL) AND COALESCE(status = $2, $2 IS NULL) AND (NOT $3 OR reference IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $4) AND ((score IS NULL AND id < $6)) AND ($6 IS NOT NULL AND $7 IS NULL) ORDER BY score DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC LIMIT $5) UNION ALL (SELECT score, id FROM transfers WHERE COALESCE(account_id = $1, $1 IS NULL) AND COALESCE(status = $2, $2 IS NULL) AND (NOT $3 OR reference IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $4) AND ($6 IS NULL) ORDER BY score DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC LIMIT $5) ORDER BY score DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC LIMIT $5) SELECT i.id AS "entity_id!: Repo__Id", e.sequence, e.event, CASE WHEN $8 THEN e.context ELSE NULL::jsonb END as "context: es_entity::ContextData", e.recorded_at, NULL::jsonb as "forgettable_payload?" FROM entities i JOIN transfer_events e ON i.id = e.id ORDER BY i.score desc nulls last, i.id desc, i.id, e.sequence
